visual_action: The video is a montage of POV-style clips showcasing life as a White House intern. Scene 1: Marine One helicopter landing/taking off on the South Lawn in daylight. Scene 2: Upward-angle shot of the White House South Portico columns against a blue sky. Scene 3: A blurry, partially obscured shot peeking through columns at what appears to be an outdoor ceremony or event with people and patriotic bunting. Scene 4 & 5: Night sky filled with colorful fireworks (gold, red, white) shot from the White House grounds with trees silhouetted below. Scene 6: A young woman with dark hair, dressed in all black business attire, bowling in what appears to be the White House bowling alley, holding an orange bowling ball. Scene 7: The American flag on a flagpole in front of the White House North Lawn, with construction cranes visible in the background and a green security cone in the foreground. Scene 8: Inside the White House East Room, a man in a dark suit (viewed from behind) stands before a large group of well-dressed young people (interns) posing for a photo under a large crystal chandelier; a portrait painting hangs on the wall behind the group.
